summary: The existing C2 failure collector can retain one unambiguous final failing public verify tuple as exact command/input/owner bytes with sizes and SHA256, joined to the final copied lane log. It considers only fixed Provider/Runner attempt names, reuses the existing public-profile shape checks, and refuses missing, changed, duplicate, private, unknown, sensitive or incoherent data. Exact bytes are not redacted and then called exact: the whole optional tuple is omitted instead. Original cause, reported cleanup and emitted client/server logs take priority over metadata. The selected reporter keeps its existing 96 KiB whole-report, 2-second collection, 3-second outer reporting, 16-file and 128-entry limits; metadata has 32/8/8 KiB raw subcaps and a 68 KiB serialized-frame cap. Closed nested producer fields refuse arbitrary environment or unknown records. The final tuple must join the adapter status, including timeout 124, and any partial later attempt refuses even if its log matches an earlier one. Previously retained file names count once; extra lookups consume the remaining allowance. All-or-nothing tuple admission with complete:false omission never renews a command deadline or changes original exit, retirement, model-checking or retry decisions. Recorded input times are diagnostic shape data rather than fresh launch authority; complete retained counterparts still do not establish current pin/alias checks or retry eligibility. Public synthetic file/JSON controls exercise exact recovery after scratch removal, superseded attempts, privacy/coherence/refusal and budget/error preservation. This is source-boundary knowledge, not formal or installed runtime qualification. A separate client limitation remains: the cited Quint 0.32.0 release-tag TLC path drops a compile-failure explanation before its generic CLI error. Retention preserves emitted evidence but cannot recover text never emitted. That source observation is not proof of the deployed binary build or a particular gRPC/protobuf failure cause; a corrected client artifact and provenance/pin transition require separate owning admission.
title: Retain complete public C2 diagnostic counterparts without granting retry authority
